thought.text: The base image already has postgresql-17 and postgis-3 installed from the same bullseye PGDG repo. Next, let's download the pgrouting .deb file (removing the extra parameters that were being rejected):

reasoning_content:
The second command errored out — is it because the "description" parameter is being rejected again? No wait, it's the first tool call in this batch — I ended up including the `description` field. I need to remove `description` from all terminal calls. Only command and summary are allowed.

Also, I found out that the base image already has postgresql-17 17.5, postgresql-17-postgis-3 3.5.2, and postgresql-17-postgis-3-scripts installed from the PGDG bullseye repo (pgdg110). And /usr/lib/postgresql/17 exists (the earlier `ls` failed because it was 17/extension — the actual path might be /usr/lib/postgresql/17/extension — but the ls of /usr/lib/postgresql shows "17". The fact that "extension" isn't there is… wait, the first command's output showed `ls /usr/lib/postgresql/` -> "17", and the `which psql` error exit code was 1, which was strange. Oh well, in this second run it was confirmed that postgresql-17 is installed.)

The pgrouting deb depends on postgresql-17 and postgresql-17-postgis (>= 3.5.x?) — since postgresql-17 17.5 and postgis-3 3.5.2 are already installed, the dependency should be satisfied.

Next, I'll download the two debs and verify the checksums.

tool_call.name: terminal
tool_call.arguments: {"command": "cd /tmp && curl -fsSL -o pgrouting.deb \"https://apt-archive.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt/pool/main/p/pgrouting/postgresql-17-pgrouting_3.8.0-1.pgdg110+1_amd64.deb\" && curl -fsSL -o pgrouting-scripts.deb \"https://apt-archive.postgresql.org/pub/repos/apt/pool/main/p/pgrouting/postgresql-17-pgrouting-scripts_3.8.0-1.pgdg110+1_all.deb\" && sha256sum pgrouting.deb pgrouting-scripts.deb", "description": "Download pgrouting debs from PGDG archive and verify checksums", "security_risk": "MEDIUM", "summary": "Download and verify pgrouting debs from archive"}
